body:
Candidates saved in separate projects could not be compared together, and README samples required repeated navigation. This adds a portable cross-project comparison gallery and displays six original previews directly in both READMEs, with one link to every sample.

- Compare explicit source versions with exact PNG/prompt downloads, decision notes, small-size previews and illustrative app/header contexts.
- Preserve unknown legacy parent layouts and restore active filters after browser Back navigation.
- Add eight native images across six initial directions and two parent-based edits, retaining mixed outcomes and original files.
- Prepare unreleased source 0.6.0, refresh the personal installation and correct current-version guidance. Published release remains v0.3.1.

Validation: 622 Python tests; Ruff, format, basedpyright and lock checks; six Node browser-restoration cases and 58 focused Python checks after the template fix; real Chrome navigation/download checks; actual installed-helper execution; five independent Orca reviews, including 30 hands-on scenarios.

See [review evidence](https://github.com/t1seo/logo-land/blob/feat/logo-land-gallery-workflow/docs/qa/gallery-workflow/review-summary.md) and [the visual gallery](https://github.com/t1seo/logo-land/blob/feat/logo-land-gallery-workflow/docs/gallery.md). Native samples remain unapproved artwork; platform packages and font composition are future work.
title: Compare logo projects and show samples directly
